_source.extraction_method: Read-only text reads of the donor .script/.global/.inc files at the cited lines. Every case line below is transcribed verbatim from the donor text (leading indentation trimmed only; inline comments retained). Channel integers and koef overrides were copied from the literal, then r/g/b were recomputed with the donor formula at classes.script:8012-8014: channel * effective_koef / 255, where an entry without an explicit koef inherits the default 1.1 declared at :7988. No donor binary was copied or executed; nothing was inferred from artwork.

format.donor: r, g, b : Float = integer_channel * koef / 255 — normalised floats, nominally 0..1 but allowed to exceed 1.0 because koef can be 1.2 (no clamp in the donor procedure).
format.godot: rgb_godot_float = [r, g, b] passed to Godot Color(r, g, b) as floats. rgb_display_clamped = same values clamped to 0..1 for display. rgb_8bit_clamped = round(min(r,1)*255) etc., derived for convenience only. Channel order is RGB, not BGR: the donor passes [0],[1],[2] to SetGameObjectUniform4fByHandle and to SetGUIElementUserColor in that order.
format.alpha: UNVERIFIED — GetKeyColorByPlayerIndex emits no alpha. misc.script:5069 declares 'var a : Float;' and :5072 assigns a:=1 ONLY when GetLibMaterialTextureFormat(GetGameObjectLibMaterialByHandle(goHnd))=2; otherwise a is left unassigned. No alpha value is stored in this file. Godot consumers must choose their own alpha explicitly.
